argv: date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; sha256sum "$2/predictions-3.txt"; git -C "$1" show b58b26fbeba8fd972e1d31ac8a9175a81e333b32:tools/mutate-and-run.sh > tools/mutate-and-run.sh; sha256sum tools/mutate-and-run.sh; wc -l < tools/mutate-and-run.sh; echo "=== sweep A on the mado revision"; bash tools/mutate-and-run.sh --target "$2/gate.sh" --defects "$2/degraded.spec" --suite "bash \"\$MUTANT\" --selftest" --workdir "$2/h597-runA" --timeout 2 2>&1; echo "[h597-A] exit=$?"; for s in dup noop; do bash tools/mutate-and-run.sh --target "$2/gate.sh" --defects "$2/$s.spec" --suite "touch \"\$WORKDIR/suite-ran.\$DEFECT_ID\"; bash \"\$MUTANT\" --selftest" --workdir "$2/h597-$s" 2>&1 | grep -E "^(MUTATE: |APPLY|spec:)"; echo "[h597-$s] exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]} markers=$(find "$2/h597-$s" -name "suite-ran.*" | wc -l)"; done
